import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/training_3.csv"
]

# List to hold the 'video' column data from each source
video_columns = []

# Load each source CSV, extract the 'video' column, and append to the list
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Extract 'video' column
    video_col = df[['video']]
    video_columns.append(video_col)

# Concatenate all video columns vertically (union)
all_videos = pd.concat(video_columns, ignore_index=True)

# Drop duplicate video entries to match the target examples style (unique videos)
all_videos_unique = all_videos.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Save the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/target_multisource_cot.csv"
all_videos_unique.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
